Privacy_Policy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy_Policy.foreword: This statement applies to the website, Property Management System (PMS), and related services of GO TECHS (collectively, "the Service").
Privacy_Policy.languageVersion: Language Priority In the event of any inconsistency between the Chinese and English versions of this statement, the Chinese version shall prevail. Any English version is for reference only.

sections.title: 1. Data Collection
paragraphs: GO TECHS collects two types of information:
Account Information: Personal information you provide when registering or contacting us (e.g., name, phone number, email address, company name).
System Data: Business data you input while using the PMS (e.g., tenant names, ID numbers, tenancy details, property addresses).

sections.title: 2. Use of Information
paragraphs: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
items: To provide, maintain, and improve PMS functionality (e.g., generating invoices, sending rent reminders).
To process your subscription orders and provide technical support.
To send you system notifications (e.g., maintenance alerts) and product updates.

sections.title: 3. Processing of Tenant Data (Important)
paragraphs: Regarding the "Tenant Data" you input into the system, GO TECHS acts solely as the Data Processor. You, as the Data Controller, are responsible for obtaining tenant consent before collecting their data. We will not use your Tenant Data for GO TECHS's marketing purposes, nor will we sell it to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Data Disclosure and Third-Party Services
paragraphs: We will not disclose your information to third parties unless necessary to fulfill your request, except in the following cases:
items: Service Providers: We may transfer data to trusted third-party infrastructure providers (e.g., cloud hosting services, SMS gateway providers, payment gateways) solely for the purpose of maintaining system operations.
Legal Requirements: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or government authority.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: The Service uses Cookies and similar technologies to identify your login status and save system preferences. If you disable Cookies, you will not be able to log in or use the system properly.

sections.title: 6. Security
paragraphs: We employ industry-standard encryption technologies (such as SSL/TLS) to transmit and store your data. Only employees who need to perform specific jobs (such as customer service or system maintenance) are granted access to relevant information.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: You may access, correct, or export your data at any time by logging into the system. If you wish to delete your account, please contact us via the email address provided on the website.

sections.title: 1. Introduction and Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: GO-TECHS Property Management System (hereinafter referred to as "GO-TECHS" or "the System") provides Property Management System (PMS) software, rental solutions, and related services through this website and cloud platform. By registering for, logging into, or using the System, you agree to read, understand, accept, and comply with the following Terms of Service. GO-TECHS reserves the right to update these terms at any time without prior notice. Users should regularly review the latest terms. If you do not agree to any of the following terms, please stop using the System immediately.

sections.title: 2. Account Registration and Security
paragraphs: To use the System, you may be required to register an account. You agree to provide true, accurate, and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality and security of your login account and password. GO-TECHS shall not be liable for any loss (including data leakage, malicious deletion, or unauthorized transactions) resulting from your failure to secure your account information. If you suspect any unauthorized use of your account, you must notify us immediately.

sections.title: 3. Data Ownership and Privacy
paragraphs: You retain full ownership of all rental data, tenant information, contracts, and documents uploaded to or entered into the GO-TECHS System ("User Data"). GO-TECHS does not claim ownership of your User Data. However, you agree to grant GO-TECHS a worldwide, royalty-free license to access, copy, and use such data solely for the purpose of providing services to you, performing system maintenance, data backup, and improving system functionality.

sections.title: 4. Fees and Payment
paragraphs: GO-TECHS services are provided on a paid subscription basis. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, all fees paid (including monthly fees, annual fees, or setup fees) are non-refundable. If you fail to pay fees on time, we reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the account upon notice until the outstanding balance is paid.

sections.title: 5. Restrictions on Use
paragraphs: The System is managed by GO-TECHS. Unless otherwise stated, the copyright of all source code, database structures, interface designs, and information within the System is owned by GO-TECHS. Without prior written permission from us, no one may copy, reverse engineer, distribute, reprint, or load onto other servers via "mirroring" any content or functions of this System for commercial purposes. Users are only authorized to use the System for internal operational purposes of managing their property rentals during the subscription period.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property and Trademarks
paragraphs: All trademarks and logos used in this System and website (including the GO-TECHS logo and name) are owned by GO-TECHS. Nothing in these terms grants (whether by implication, waiver, or estoppel) users permission to use these trademarks and logos without the written authorization of GO-TECHS.

sections.title: 7. Termination and Data Retention
paragraphs: If you decide to terminate your subscription, you are responsible for exporting all your data before the contract ends. Upon termination of service, GO-TECHS reserves the right to permanently delete all your account data and backups after [30] days from the contract end date and assumes no responsibility for data recovery thereafter.

sections.title: 8. Indemnity
paragraphs: If your use of the GO-TECHS System (including but not limited to illegal tenant data entry, contract data errors, or misuse of system functions) causes loss to GO-TECHS, including third-party claims and liabilities, data destruction, losses, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees and costs), you agree to defend GO-TECHS's interests and fully indemnify GO-TECHS for such losses.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of Liability and Disclaimer
paragraphs: The services provided by the System are on an "as is" and "as available" basis. GO-TECHS strives to provide stable rental management services but is not responsible for ensuring that the System's calculation results (e.g., rent, management fees, tax calculations) and legal document templates are absolutely accurate. Users must verify the data output by the System and the legal validity of contracts themselves.

In no event shall GO-TECHS or its suppliers be liable for any direct, indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages. This includes, but is not limited to: loss of rental income, loss of business opportunities, data loss, or business interruption caused by the use or inability to use this PMS.

sections.title: 10. Governing Law and Language
paragraphs: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. You submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Hong Kong courts for any disputes related to these terms. In the event of any inconsistency between the Chinese and English versions of these terms, the Chinese version shall prevail.
